verdict.rationale: Sentry has automation-like features such as alert rules, ownership and fingerprint rules, and Seer autofix, so asking whether those automations can be versioned and rolled back is fair, and the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of version history, review, or rollback for these automations. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: dotagents locks versions of agent skill dependencies, and the releases CLI manages application releases, not automation configuration.
